name: cmux.composer.chip/1
docs: Context chips for the agent chat composer: short labels the person clicks to add the chip's insert text to the draft. Data in the manifest; the daemon lists them (apps.composer.list chips) from enabled, visible apps, so a save of cmux-app.json updates the chips without a restart.

id.description: Stable within the extension; the composer keys the chip by app and id.

insert.description: The text a click adds to the draft, at the caret.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
